evals.prompt: /backtest supertrend NIFTY NSE 15m - I want to see if a 15 minute supertrend on nifty is worth trading
evals.expected_output: Reads dhan-backtest-data before the vendor backtest skill. Uses dhan_data.load_ohlcv('NIFTY','15m') (session-filtered, 25 bars/session), pandas_ta or lib.intraday_signals.supertrend instead of openalgo.ta, NIFTY benchmark from the repo CSV, no yfinance/OpenAlgo. Reports describe() window and trade count, gross and net of costs, a one-bar-shifted run, and states the supertrend implementation used.

evals.prompt: backtest an ORB strategy on RELIANCE using 1 minute data for the last year
evals.expected_output: Notices stock 1-min data is Nifty-50-only and only ~4 months (manifest.json), says a year is not available from repo data and does not fetch from yfinance or another provider; offers the available window with a robustness caveat or a daily-data alternative.

evals.prompt: run /optimize on ema crossover for TCS, find the best fast/slow periods
evals.expected_output: Uses load_ohlcv('TCS','D'), a heatmap over the grid, warns about in-sample curve-fitting and asks for or performs an out-of-sample/walk-forward check, reports net of costs, and saves keepers under scripts/analysis/ rather than an untracked backtesting/ folder.
